purpose: Graded propeller efficiency observations and residual gaps for the seven-aircraft Normal/Combat benchmark. Research only.

eta_80_percent.basis: Greg Mustang workbook constant; supported by level-speed replays on F4U-4, P-51B low-blower, Spitfire LF IX closed radiators.
eta_80_percent.use: Starting value inside tested level-flight envelopes; not universal.

eta_76_percent_p47b_military.basis: Mean of close matches to NACA L4L07 military climb series (≈0.75–0.76); high-load Curtiss runs 24-5/24-2 give 0.801/0.759.
eta_76_percent_p47b_military.use: P-47B 2700 rpm military climb with matched open-cooling area; tip-Mach level curve endpoint.

aircraft.matched_condition: Clean Normal and Military level, chart power, BuNo 80765
aircraft.source: Wright Field / VF-96 level trial; existing replay MAE 3.10 mph (was 7.38)
aircraft.residual_gap: High-blower shaft-power and climb plates still open

aircraft.matched_condition: 2700 rpm military climb + open cooling; tip-Mach level curve 0.979→1.035
aircraft.source: NACA L4L07 Tables I–II; Wright Field 41-5902 / 41-5942
aircraft.residual_gap: Installation loss split still coarse; hold endpoints only over tested domain

aircraft.source: Wright Field Eng-47-1749-A; existing level checks
aircraft.residual_gap: High-blower is a separate test condition; Fig. 5 remains diagnostic

aircraft.source: A&AEE BS.543 Tables II and V

aircraft.matched_condition: Part-power level, recorded TAS/BHP/RPM at 5000 and 24400 ft, faired shutters
aircraft.residual_gap: Full-power level and open-shutter climb need joint power/drag check

aircraft.matched_condition: Combat 2400 rpm, closed flaps, internal vs long intake, ~3870 kg

aircraft.matched_condition: DB 601 E 1.30 ata / 2500 rpm combat schedule
